title: New Level II trauma designation expands regional emergency care
author: Communications team
summary: Harlow Creek Medical Center is now a state-designated Level II trauma center, keeping more critically injured patients close to home.
body:
After a multi-year investment in surgeons, nursing and equipment, Harlow Creek Medical Center has received Level II trauma designation. That means patients with serious injuries can often stay in the region instead of being transferred farther away.

The emergency department already operated 24 hours a day. The designation adds formal trauma team activation pathways and continuous coverage by trauma surgeons.

title: Northridge Cancer Pavilion opens private infusion suite
author: Cancer care team
summary: Sixteen private infusion chairs, a quiet family lounge and same-day lab draws are now open at Northridge.
body: Patients starting chemotherapy or infusion therapy can now be treated in private chairs with windows and room for a caregiver. A family lounge and same-day lab station sit on the same floor.

title: Free community flu clinics start in October
author: Community health
summary: Walk-in flu shots for ages six months and up at Millhaven Urgent Care and Ashford Family Clinic on select Saturdays.
body: Harlow Creek Health System will offer walk-in flu clinics on three Saturdays in October. Bring your insurance card if you have one; uninsured patients are welcome at no charge while supplies last.

title: Harlow Creek named a top workplace for nurses in the region
author: People and culture
summary: Third-party survey highlights staffing ratios, tuition support and shared governance.
body: In a regional nursing survey, Harlow Creek scored highly for staffing, tuition reimbursement and shared governance councils. More than 1,100 nurses work across the system.

title: Patient portal adds video visit scheduling for primary care
author: Digital health
summary: Established primary care patients can now book and join telehealth visits from the portal.
body: Video visits are available for many follow-ups and medication check-ins. Not every concern is right for telehealth; your clinic will help you choose.

title: Joint replacement pathway shortens typical hospital stay
author: Orthopedics
summary: Most hip and knee replacement patients now go home the day after surgery when it is clinically appropriate.
body: A redesigned pathway covering education, anesthesia, therapy and discharge planning has shortened typical stays for elective joint replacement. Outcomes are monitored by the Orthopedic Institute quality committee.

title: Creekway Heart Center expands evening clinic hours
author: Heart and vascular
summary: Cardiology follow-ups are now available until 6 pm on Tuesdays and Thursdays.
body: Evening clinics make it easier for patients who work during the day to keep follow-up appointments without missing a full shift.

title: Volunteer chaplain program welcomes new cohort
author: Mission and ministry
summary: Trained volunteer chaplains will support patients and families across the main campus.
body: Chaplains are available on request for any faith tradition, or for no tradition at all. The service is free and separate from clinical care.
